returned_title: Federal Parliament Election 1972 (Panel: 2nd Wave, October 1971 - January 1972)
justification: Exact title match. The dataset is catalogued by CESSDA and provided by the GESIS Data Archive for the Social Sciences. It covers political attitudes, party preferences, voting behavior, evaluations of political candidates Willy Brandt and Rainer Barzel, and demographic characteristics in the context of the 1972 West German federal parliamentary election. The dataset corresponds specifically to the second wave of the panel study, conducted between October 1971 and January 1972.

returned_title: Federal Parliament Election 1972 (Panel: 2nd Wave, October 1971 - January 1972) — SelectDataset
justification: Alternative dataset discovery page containing the exact requested title. The record identifies CESSDA as its source and GESIS Data Archive for the Social Sciences as the data provider. It includes a detailed description of the survey's political, electoral, socioeconomic, and demographic variables and links to the CESSDA catalogue record.

returned_title: Social Change and Violent Crime: A Comparison of Germany, England and Sweden, 1950–2000 (Sozialer Wandel und Gewaltkriminalität)
justification: This is the closest verified match to the requested title. The publication by Helmut Thome and Christoph Birkel (2007), titled 'Sozialer Wandel und Gewaltkriminalität: Deutschland, England und Schweden im Vergleich, 1950–2000,' is explicitly identified in documentation about the GESIS historical statistics database (histat). It examines social change and violent crime across Germany, England, and Sweden between 1950 and 2000. The linked documentation provides evidence of the research and its connection to historical statistical data, but it is not a direct dataset landing page. A dedicated dataset record or DOI could not be verified.

returned_title: Social Science Telephone Interviews among the General Public via the Mobile Phone Net (CELLA 1)
justification: This DOI identifies the CELLA 1 dataset archived by GESIS – Leibniz Institute for the Social Sciences, Germany. The study, conducted in cooperation with Technische Universität Dresden, investigated social science telephone surveys of the general population using mobile phones and landlines. The dataset is referenced in academic publications under its German title, 'Telefonbefragungen in der Allgemeinbevölkerung über das Mobilfunknetz 2009.' It is the original CELLA study, distinct from the subsequent CELLA 2.0 project. The DOI provides a persistent identifier for locating the dataset.

returned_title: Political Situation in West Berlin (Young People from the GDR)
justification: Exact title match. This dataset is archived by GESIS – Leibniz Institute for the Social Sciences under study number ZA0590 (Version 1.0.0). It was produced by USIA, Washington, and DIVO, Frankfurt, and published in 1974. The study examines political and economic attitudes among young people from the German Democratic Republic (GDR), particularly in relation to the situation in West Berlin. The DOI provides a persistent link to the dataset's official GESIS record.

returned_title: General Public´s Trust in Politics
justification: Exact title match. This dataset (study number ZA6621, version 1.0.0) was published in 2016 by the GESIS Data Archive in Cologne, Germany. It was produced by the Press and Information Office of the German Federal Government (Presse- und Informationsamt der Bundesregierung, Berlin). The dataset examines public trust in democracy, politics, political parties, and politicians, as well as political participation, media, and opinions on Germany's political situation. Data were collected through computer-assisted telephone interviews (CATI) from April 4 to April 27, 2016, involving 1,510 respondents aged 18 and older in Germany. The dataset contains 134 variables and is available in SPSS, Stata, and CSV formats. The DOI provides access to the official dataset record.

returned_title: General Public´s Trust in Politics — GESIS Dataset Landing Page
justification: Official GESIS research data catalog entry for the exact requested dataset. The landing page provides the dataset's metadata, abstract, methodology, bibliographic information, version history, and citation details. It confirms the dataset identifier ZA6621, publication year 2016, version 1.0.0, and DOI 10.4232/1.12710. This is the authoritative repository landing page for locating and accessing the dataset.

returned_title: Second European Survey of Enterprises on New and Emerging Risks, 2014 (ESENER-2) — GESIS Data Archive
justification: Exact match for the requested dataset. Published by GESIS Data Archive in 2018, this dataset contains results from the second European Survey of Enterprises on New and Emerging Risks, conducted in 2014. It covers 49,320 establishments across 36 European countries and examines occupational safety and health management, psychosocial risks, workplace risk assessments, and employee participation. This DOI provides a persistent identifier for the dataset.

returned_title: Second European Survey of Enterprises on New and Emerging Risks, 2014 — UK Data Service
justification: Exact match for ESENER-2, archived by the UK Data Service under study number 7808. The dataset was created by the European Agency for Safety and Health at Work (EU-OSHA) and TNS Infratest Sozialforschung. It contains establishment-level survey data about occupational health and safety practices, emerging workplace risks, and psychosocial risk management. The UK Data Service identifies these data as safeguarded, meaning access conditions apply.

returned_title: Second European Survey of Enterprises on New and Emerging Risks, 2014 (ESENER-2) — B2FIND
justification: Exact title match in the B2FIND research data discovery portal. It identifies GESIS Data Archive as the publisher and provides the dataset DOI 10.4232/1.12965. Useful for discovering dataset metadata and locating the archived research data.

returned_title: European Survey of Enterprises on New and Emerging Risks, 2014 — European Data Portal
justification: Official European Data Portal catalogue entry for the 2014 ESENER-2 dataset. The record is associated with EU-OSHA and provides an additional authoritative discovery point for European occupational safety and health survey data.

returned_title: ESENER 2014 — European Agency for Safety and Health at Work (EU-OSHA)
justification: Official EU-OSHA survey overview for ESENER-2, confirming that the second survey wave was conducted during summer and autumn 2014. Particularly useful for understanding the survey methodology, scope, and findings.

returned_title: Partnership Conflicts and Psychosomatic Gynecological Illnesses 1988/89 (Additional Survey: Sterile Women)
justification: Exact match found in the GESIS Data Archive. It covers research conducted in 1988–1989 among women experiencing primary or secondary infertility in the German Democratic Republic (East Germany). Participants were selected through the gynecological outpatient clinic at Charité, Berlin. The dataset is published by GESIS, has the persistent DOI 10.4232/1.6370, and is available for academic research and teaching. The GESIS record confirms the English title, study period, target population, and dataset identity.

Jung listed as the principal investigator and the Bundesministerium für Gesundheit (Federal Ministry of Health) as the funding organization. returned_title: "Arma sunt necessaria" (Arms are necessary): Guns, Gun Culture and Cultural Origins of the Second Amendment to the U.S. Constitution
justification: Exact match found in the GESIS Data Archive. The dataset was created by Michael Lenz and published in 2009 by GESIS. It examines the historical and cultural origins of American gun culture and the Second Amendment to the U.S. Constitution, covering the period 1732–1791, with geographical coverage including Massachusetts and South Carolina. The dataset is classified as historical research data, is available for academic research and teaching, and has the persistent DOI 10.4232/1.8413. The GESIS catalog confirms the title, author, publication year, and dataset identifier.

returned_title: A Survey of Europe Today (Finland)
justification: Exact match for the requested dataset. Archived by GESIS – Leibniz Institute for the Social Sciences under study number ZA1296, Version 1.0.0. Conducted by Reader's Digest, London, the survey collected data in Finland between January and March 1969. It includes 1,485 respondents aged 18 and older and 1,167 variables covering consumer behavior, household furnishings, economic conditions, country perceptions, leisure activities, and attitudes toward European integration. The dataset was published by the GESIS Data Archive in 1983 and is part of a comparative study covering 16 European countries. The DOI provides a persistent link to the official dataset record.

returned_title: A Survey of Europe Today (Finland) – GESIS Data Catalogue
justification: Official GESIS dataset landing page for the exact requested title. Provides detailed metadata, including the study description, sampling methodology, geographic coverage, data collection dates, variables, publication information, and dataset version history. The record identifies Reader's Digest, London, as the responsible organization and confirms DOI 10.4232/1.1296. This is the primary catalogue page for locating and accessing the dataset.

returned_title: College Education and Profession
justification: Exact title match. This dataset is archived by the GESIS Data Archive and is also known by its German title, 'Hochschulausbildung und Beruf.' Published in 1985, it examines the educational experiences and professional situations of graduates from the University of Munich and the Technical University of Munich who completed their studies in 1972. The survey was conducted between May and June 1975. Its topics include academic experiences, educational backgrounds, career transitions, employment conditions, and professional satisfaction. The dataset is identified by DOI 10.4232/1.1458.

returned_title: College Education and Profession — GESIS Data Search
justification: Verified dataset metadata record in the GESIS Data Search Knowledge Graph. It explicitly identifies the dataset as 'College Education and Profession,' provides its German title, identifies Georg Kärtner and Walter Hornstein as creators, and confirms its publication year (1985), geographic coverage (Munich, Bavaria, Germany), and DOI (10.4232/1.1458). This is an authoritative catalog record for the requested dataset.

returned_title: 50 Years of the German D-Mark: Monetary Statistics from 1948 to 1997
justification: A closely related historical dataset published by the Deutsche Bundesbank and hosted by GESIS (Study ZA8186, Version 3.0.0). It contains approximately 25,000 time series covering Germany's monetary, banking, financial, and economic development from 1948 to 1997. Although its title does not exactly match '50 Years Federal Republic of Germany,' it provides extensive statistical information about the Federal Republic of Germany during its first 50 years. This is the closest relevant dataset identified.

returned_title: Citizen Survey Duisburg (Spring 2000)
justification: Exact match found in the GESIS Data Archive. The dataset is also titled 'Duisburger Bürgerumfrage Frühjahr 2000' in German. It was published in 2001 and covers a citizen survey conducted in Duisburg, Germany, between February and March 2000. The survey population consists of Duisburg residents aged 18–75. Topics include housing, community life, cultural participation, political attitudes, and local government. The dataset has GESIS study identifier ZA3468, version 1.0.0, and DOI 10.4232/1.3468. Data and documentation are available for academic research and teaching.

returned_title: Flash Eurobarometer 10 (Managers)
justification: Exact match for the requested dataset. Archived by GESIS Data Archive under study identifier ZA2146, Version 1.0.0. Published in 1992, the dataset contains survey responses from 2,440 managers of small and medium-sized enterprises across 12 European Community countries. The survey was conducted in April 1992 and examines managers' awareness and use of European institutions, economic support programs, information sources, and international business assistance. The dataset contains 88 variables and is available through the official GESIS repository.

returned_title: Flash Eurobarometer 10 (Managers) — GESIS Data Catalogue
justification: Official GESIS dataset landing page providing the study description, bibliographic metadata, methodology, geographic coverage, version information, and access to research data. The catalogue provides access to dataset files and supporting documentation, subject to GESIS registration requirements.

returned_title: Labour market policy in the German Empire (Arbeitsmarktpolitik im Deutschen Kaiserreich)
justification: Exact title match. This dataset is archived by GESIS – Leibniz Institute for the Social Sciences and was created by Anselm Faust. The dataset concerns labour market policies in the German Empire, including employment placement, job creation, and unemployment assistance. Its associated historical research examines the period 1890–1918, while the dataset metadata specifies temporal coverage of 1904–1928. The dataset is available for academic research and teaching. DOI: 10.4232/1.10284. The GESIS catalog confirms the exact English title and corresponding German title.

returned_title: Duisburg Citizen Survey (Autumn 2002, Foreign population)
justification: GESIS Data Archive contains the Duisburg Citizen Survey series, including the Autumn 2002 survey. This is a related dataset rather than an exact match.

justification: GESIS Data Archive hosts the historical Sofortresonanzen DDR Fernsehen survey series, including datasets from 1984. The provided URL leads to the official publication documenting the dataset, rather than a direct dataset landing page. A dedicated dataset landing page, downloadable data files, and DOI could not be independently verified.

returned_title: The CFS’s (Center for Financial Studies) Historical Money and Capital Market Database, Germany 1871 to 1914
justification: Exact match for the requested dataset. Published by GESIS Data Archive in 2008 (dataset identifier ZA8286), it contains historical German money and capital market data covering 1871–1914. Developed by the Center for Financial Studies at Goethe University Frankfurt, it includes more than 100,000 bond market observations and extensive stock market data from six major German financial centers: Berlin, Frankfurt, Hamburg, Leipzig, Cologne, and Munich. This DOI is the dataset's official persistent identifier.

returned_title: Die historische Geld- und Kapitaldatenbank des Center for Financial Studies
justification: Original institutional repository containing the historical financial database developed by the Center for Financial Studies at Goethe University Frankfurt. This landing page provides downloadable Excel datasets for the six German stock exchanges, along with documentation in PDF and Word formats. It covers 1871–1914 and includes approximately 700,000 stock market observations and more than 100,000 bond market observations. Particularly useful for directly accessing the underlying data files.

justification: European research data catalog record matching the requested dataset title exactly. Identifies GESIS Data Archive as the publisher and confirms that the dataset is available for academic research and teaching.

justification: Research data catalog entry documenting the same historical German financial database for 1871–1914. Describes monthly share prices, share capital, and dividend information for companies listed on six major German stock exchanges. Provides information about the dataset's structure, Excel files, supporting documentation, publisher, and licensing.

returned_title: The Death Penalty (1978) — General Social Survey
justification: This is a relevant match for the requested dataset. The question asks whether respondents favor or oppose the death penalty for persons convicted of murder. The landing page provides information about the survey measure and its source. The exact standalone dataset title 'The Death Penalty (1978)' could not be independently confirmed.

Study ZA6349 concerns the March 1990 East German parliamentary election, while ZA6348 concerns the October 1990 state parliamentary election. Study ZA6350 is a plausible candidate for the requested May 1990 municipal election survey, but its exact title and DOI could not be independently verified because the dataset page was inaccessible.

returned_title: Decatur Study (Personal Influence)
justification: Exact match for the requested dataset, archived by GESIS Data Archive. Conducted by Paul F. Lazarsfeld and Elihu Katz, the study examines personal influence, opinion leadership, and interpersonal communication in Decatur, Illinois. The data were collected between June and August 1945 using a two-wave panel survey. The dataset is relevant to research on social networks, communication, and the influence of interpersonal relationships on opinions and decisions. GESIS identifies the dataset with DOI 10.4232/1.0241 and indicates that the data and documentation are available for academic research and teaching.

returned_title: Decatur Study Personal Influence — GESIS Data Search
justification: GESIS dataset metadata landing page confirming the exact dataset title, authors Paul F. Lazarsfeld and Elihu Katz, publication year 1945, geographic coverage of Decatur, Illinois, and the study's two-wave panel survey design. This record provides an authoritative source for identifying the dataset and its persistent DOI.

returned_title: Cologne Study (Reader Analysis of the Koelner Stadt-Anzeiger) / Köln-Studie (Leseranalyse Kölner Stadt-Anzeiger)
justification: Exact match for the requested dataset. Published in 1988 and archived by GESIS Data Archive, this study examines leisure activities, consumer behavior, shopping habits, travel preferences, transportation, household characteristics, and demographic information among residents within the circulation area of the Kölner Stadt-Anzeiger newspaper. The survey covers individuals aged 14 and older in Cologne, Bonn, Leverkusen, and surrounding districts in Germany. The dataset is registered with DOI 10.4232/1.1635 and is indexed in the B2FIND research data catalog.

returned_title: Cologne Study (Reader Analysis of the Koelner Stadt-Anzeiger) — B2FIND Dataset Record
justification: Verified dataset landing page in the B2FIND research data discovery portal. DuMont Schauberg, Köln), publication year (1988), publisher (GESIS Data Archive), and the dataset's persistent DOI. This is an alternative discovery page for the same dataset.

returned_title: Learning Progression Analytics - Analyse und Förderung von Lernverläufen zur Entwicklung von Kompetenzen (LPA-AFLEK) / Learning Progression Analytics - Analysing and Promoting Learning Progressions to Develop Skills (LPA-AFLEK)
justification: Exact match for the requested dataset. Published by GESIS in 2025 (version 1.0.0), the dataset documents the LPA-AFLEK research project conducted by the Leibniz Institute for Science and Mathematics Education (IPN), the Leibniz Institute for Educational Research and Educational Information (DIPF), and Ruhr University Bochum. The research examines individual student learning progressions using data collected during digital physics lessons, with the goal of identifying learning difficulties and supporting teachers through learning analytics dashboards. The study involves students in grades 7 and 8 at secondary schools in Schleswig-Holstein, Germany. The DOI provides a persistent identifier for the dataset.

This is an alternative discovery and metadata access point for the same dataset, not a separate dataset.

It covers public attitudes, concerns, and perceptions related to the COVID-19 pandemic in Germany during calendar week 13 of 2020. returned_title: German Internet Panel, Wave 51 (January 2021)
justification: Exact match for the requested dataset. returned_title: Forsa-Bus 1992

The dataset belongs to the Forsa-Bus series of representative telephone surveys conducted by the German polling institute FORSA, covering political preferences, voting behavior, and attitudes toward political and social issues. The URL follows GESIS's official dataset landing-page format, although the specific page could not be independently verified.

returned_title: Flash Eurobarometer 550 (EU Challenges and Priorities) – GESIS Data Archive
justification: Exact match for the requested dataset. Archived by GESIS – Leibniz Institute for the Social Sciences under study identifier ZA8870, version 1.0.0. It covers public perceptions of the EU's strengths, challenges, policy priorities, democracy, economic prospects, security, and future. This DOI provides persistent access to the dataset and its documentation.

returned_title: Situation Report Medium-Sized Companies 1991/20
justification: Exact title match. This dataset is cataloged by CESSDA and provided by the GESIS Data Archive for the Social Sciences. It examines the economic situation of medium-sized companies in the Rhineland-Westphalia region of Germany during 1991, including business performance, turnover, costs, profits, investments, employment, and expectations for 1992. The dataset also covers business expansion and investment opportunities in former East Germany following German reunification. The URL points to the dataset's CESSDA catalog record.

returned_title: The Berlin Pulse 2024/25 – German Foreign Policy Survey
justification: Official landing page published by Körber-Stiftung for The Berlin Pulse 2024/25. Contains results from the 2024 representative survey of German public opinion on foreign policy, including international security, Germany's global role, relations with the United States, the war in Ukraine, and European cooperation. This is the closest verified match to the requested dataset titled 'The Berlin Pulse - German Foreign Policy 2024'.

returned_title: The Berlin Pulse 2024/2025 – Survey Results (Forsa)

returned_title: Youth Industrial Health and Safety in Practice in Hesse from the Perspective of Young People (Die Praktizierung des Jugendarbeitsschutzes in Hessen aus der Sicht Jugendlicher)

The study examines the implementation of youth occupational health and safety regulations in Hesse, Germany, from the perspective of young people. Data were collected between October 1983 and April 1984 from vocational students in their second or third year of training, covering 18 occupational groups, 171 classes, and 27 vocational schools in Hesse. The dataset's DOI is 10.4232/1.1376. Access is restricted to academic research and teaching and requires written authorization from the data depositor. The title, DOI, study population, and publication details are confirmed by the GESIS dataset catalog.

returned_title: German Business Panel, Covid-19 Survey (2020/2021). Data File for On-Site Use (ZA7746)

returned_title: International Social Survey Programme: National Identity III - ISSP 2013 (Netherlands)
justification: Exact match for the requested dataset. Archived by GESIS Data Archive in Cologne, Germany, under study number ZA5517 (Version 1.0.0). Authored by Harry Ganzeboom of Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam and published in 2017. The dataset contains survey responses from 1,638 participants in the Netherlands, collected between April and September 2014. It includes 130 variables addressing national identity, national pride, immigration, cultural identity, and attitudes toward international organizations. This is the official DOI for the Netherlands-specific ISSP 2013 National Identity III dataset.

returned_title: International Social Survey Programme: National Identity III - ISSP 2013 (Netherlands) — GESIS Data Catalogue
justification: Official dataset landing page at GESIS, the authoritative repository for International Social Survey Programme data. returned_title: ISSP-NL 2013 & 2014: Citizenship and National Identity
justification: Closely related Netherlands-specific dataset covering the ISSP 2013 National Identity III and ISSP 2014 Citizenship II modules. This dataset is more extensive than the Netherlands-specific ISSP file archived at GESIS and may be useful for researchers seeking additional Dutch survey variables and documentation.

returned_title: The Reichstag Elections and Reich Presidential Elections in Kiel 1925-1932
justification: Exact match found in the GESIS Data Archive. This dataset was authored by Wolfram Schulz and published in 2008 under study number ZA8080 (Version 1.0.0). It contains election results from 156 voting districts in Kiel, Germany, covering Reichstag elections in 1928, 1930, July 1932, and November 1932, as well as Reich Presidential elections in 1925 and 1932. The dataset contains 50 variables and is available in SPSS and Stata formats. The DOI links to the official dataset record maintained by GESIS.

returned_title: Crime in the Modern City (CrimoC) – Duisburg Longitudinal Study, 2007 (Wave 6)
justification: The Crime in the Modern City (CrimoC) longitudinal study investigates juvenile delinquency and criminal behavior in Duisburg, Germany. The study began in 2002, and its sixth survey wave was conducted in 2007, when participants were approximately 18 years old. The linked publication confirms the existence of the 2007 data collection. However, this is a supporting publication rather than a verified dataset landing page, and a DOI specifically for the 2007 dataset could not be confirmed.

returned_title: Crime in the Modern City: A Longitudinal Study of Juvenile Delinquency in Münster – Panel Study in 4 Waves (2000–2003)
justification: This is a verified dataset archived by GESIS Data Archive, produced by Klaus Boers and Jost Reinecke. It belongs to the Crime in the Modern City research project and contains longitudinal data on juvenile delinquency. Although its data collection covers 2000–2003 rather than 2007, it is a closely related dataset with an official DOI. The associated research was also documented in a 2007 publication by Boers and Reinecke. Access requires authorization for academic research.

returned_title: MZ 1998 (German Microcensus 1998)
justification: Exact title match. This is the official dataset metadata page for MZ 1998, hosted by GESIS – Leibniz Institute for the Social Sciences. The dataset contains information from the 1998 German Microcensus, including demographic characteristics, employment, education, household composition, housing conditions, and migration. The metadata reports 507,861 observations and provides access to study documentation, methodological information, and variable descriptions.

returned_title: MZ 1998 – Cross-sectional Dataset Variables
justification: Official GESIS metadata page providing a detailed thematic classification of variables in the MZ 1998 dataset. Includes demographic, socioeconomic, employment, nationality, migration, and household variables. Useful for examining the dataset's contents and identifying variables relevant to research.

returned_title: German Microcensus (Mikrozensus) – Research Data Centre

returned_title: Comparative National Development Project (Uruguay)
justification: Exact match for the requested dataset. Authored by Seymour M. Lipset and archived by GESIS Data Archive under study number ZA0401, Version 1.0.0. The dataset contains survey data collected in 1966 from 475 university students in Montevideo, Uruguay. It examines political, social, and economic attitudes, educational experiences, career aspirations, and perceptions of political institutions. The DOI provides a persistent link to the official dataset record.

returned_title: Comparative National Development Project (Uruguay) — GESIS Data Search
justification: Official GESIS dataset landing page confirming the exact title, principal investigator Seymour M. Lipset, publication year 1966, DOI 10.4232/1.0401, and study identifier ZA0401. Includes detailed methodology, survey population, sample size, bibliographic information, and dataset access information. The study belongs to the broader Comparative National Development Project, encompassing GESIS studies ZA0397 through ZA0403.

returned_title: International Social Survey Programme: Work Orientations IV - ISSP 2015 (Turkey)
justification: Exact match for the requested dataset. Published by the GESIS Data Archive in 2018, this dataset is identified by study number ZA5520 (Version 1.0.0). The authors are Ali Çarkoğlu and Ersin Kalaycıoğlu. It contains survey data from 1,535 respondents in Turkey, collected between August 26 and November 15, 2017, covering work orientations, employment conditions, job characteristics, and attitudes toward work. The Turkish dataset is available separately because it was submitted too late for inclusion in the integrated international ISSP 2015 dataset. This DOI leads to the official GESIS dataset record.

returned_title: ISSP 2015 - Work Orientations IV - GESIS Official Documentation
justification: Official GESIS documentation page for the ISSP 2015 Work Orientations IV survey. It explicitly confirms that Turkey's data, comprising 1,535 respondents, is available separately under study number ZA5520 rather than in the integrated international dataset. This page provides additional information about survey methodology, participating countries, questionnaires, and data access.

returned_title: EVS - European Values Study 1999 - Great Britain
justification: Exact match for the requested dataset. This is the Great Britain national dataset from the 1999 European Values Study (EVS), archived by GESIS – Leibniz Institute for the Social Sciences. Its study identifier is ZA3777, and the dataset is available as Version 3.0.1, released on December 28, 2012. The survey includes 1,000 respondents interviewed between October 1 and November 30, 1999. It covers social values, religion, politics, family, work, morality, and attitudes toward society.

returned_title: European Values Study 1999 – Great Britain (Official GESIS Documentation)
justification: Official GESIS documentation for the 1999 European Values Study. Identifies Great Britain as national dataset ZA3777 and provides information about the survey methodology, participating countries, sample sizes, data collection dates, and access to national datasets. This authoritative source independently confirms the requested dataset.

returned_title: European Values Study 1999 – Integrated Dataset
justification: Official integrated dataset for the 1999 European Values Study, archived by GESIS under study identifier ZA3811, Version 3.0.0. It contains harmonized survey data from 33 countries and regions, including Great Britain. This dataset is relevant for researchers seeking to compare the Great Britain results with other European countries.

returned_title: Young People and Adults '85 (Adult)
justification: Exact match found in the GESIS Data Archive under the English title 'Young People and Adults 85 Adult' (German: 'Jugendliche und Erwachsene 85 Erwachsene'). This dataset is part of the 1985 Shell Youth Study (Shell Jugendstudie), which examined generational differences in Germany. The survey was conducted between April and May 1984 and covers adults aged 45–54 in West Germany, including West Berlin. The dataset is archived under ZA Study No. 1439, with DOI 10.4232/1.1439. Data and documentation are available for academic research and teaching. The corresponding survey of young people aged 15–24 is archived separately under ZA Study No. 1438.

returned_title: Flash Eurobarometer 223 (Euro Introduction in Malta)
justification: Exact match for the requested dataset. Published in 2008 by the GESIS Data Archive, this dataset examines public attitudes toward the introduction of the euro in Malta. It is identified by DOI 10.4232/1.4809, has dataset version 1.0.0, and is available for download.

returned_title: Flash Eurobarometer 223 (Euro Introduction in Malta) — GESIS Data Catalogue

returned_title: Flash Eurobarometer 223: Euro Introduction in Malta — European Union Open Data Portal

Includes survey documentation and downloadable statistical tables.

returned_title: Flash Eurobarometer 223 (Euro Introduction in Malta) — da|ra Metadata Registry

returned_title: Election Study 1987 (Politbarometer, November 1986)
justification: This is the matching dataset identified as GESIS Study ZA1529. The official GESIS codebook for Election Study 1987 (ZA1536) explicitly lists 'Wahlstudie 1987 (Politbarometer, November 1986)' under study number ZA1529. Data collection took place in November 1986, with 1,007 respondents. The survey was conducted by MARPLAN, Offenbach, for Forschungsgruppe Wahlen, Mannheim. It examines political attitudes, party preferences, voting intentions, evaluations of political leaders, and issues surrounding the January 1987 German federal election. The GESIS study identifier is verified in the official documentation, although the individual landing page could not be independently confirmed.

returned_title: Sofortresonanzen DDR Fernsehen 21. Woche 1986 (SFR 21/86)
justification: Exact dataset match found in the GESIS Data Archive, indexed by GESIS Data Search Knowledge Graph. The dataset examines television viewing behavior and audience responses in the German Democratic Republic (DDR) during the 21st week of 1986. It was produced by the Staatliches Komitee für Fernsehen beim Ministerrat der DDR, Abteilung Soziologische Forschung, Berlin. Published on May 26, 2011, with DOI 10.4232/1.10467, the dataset is part of a collection of 464 studies documenting television viewing behavior in the DDR between 1980 and 1990. The archive indicates that data and documentation are available for academic research and teaching.

returned_title: Representatives in the Reichstag in the Weimar Republic 1919-1933
justification: Exact match for the requested dataset. Authored by Heinrich Best and published by the GESIS Data Archive in 1990 (Study ZA8007, Version 1.0.0). The dataset examines the 1,794 representatives who served in the Weimar National Assembly and the German Reichstag between 1919 and 1933, including the Reichstag elected in March 1933. It contains historical and biographical information relevant to research on parliamentary elites, political representation, and the Weimar Republic. The dataset is registered under DOI 10.4232/1.8007. Access to the data requires written authorization from the data depositor for academic research or teaching.

returned_title: Representatives in the Reichstag in the Weimar Republic 1919-1933 — GESIS Data Search Knowledge Graph
justification: Official GESIS dataset metadata record confirming the exact English title and German title, 'Abgeordnete der Reichstage der Weimarer Republik 1919-1933.' The record identifies Heinrich Best as the creator, GESIS Data Archive as the publisher, 1990 as the publication year, and 1919–1933 as the temporal coverage. It also provides information about the study population, access conditions, and related research publications. This landing page is useful for verifying the dataset's identity and bibliographic details.

returned_title: Eurobarometer 47.2: Women and Cancer, the European Parliament, and Expectations of the European Union, April-June 1997
justification: Exact match for Eurobarometer 47.2 (Apr-Jun 1997). This dataset is archived by the Inter-university Consortium for Political and Social Research (ICPSR) under study number 2090. It contains survey data collected across 15 European Union member states between April and June 1997, covering public attitudes toward the European Union, the European Parliament, women's health, and cancer prevention. The DOI provides a persistent link to the dataset and its documentation.

It is relevant for researchers interested in young Europeans' attitudes toward European integration, employment, religion, and social issues. This is a companion dataset rather than the exact requested dataset.

This provides an alternative archival source for the related youth dataset.

returned_title: EUvox2014: Voting Advice Application data for the 2014 European Parliament elections
justification: Exact match for the requested dataset. Published in 2018 by GESIS – Leibniz Institute for the Social Sciences, with Fernando Mendez as the primary researcher and Vasileios Manavopoulos as a contributor. The dataset contains individual responses collected through the EUvox2014 Voting Advice Application during the 2014 European Parliament elections. Variables include demographics, voting intentions, political preferences, ideological self-placement, probability of voting for competing parties, and responses to policy statements. This is the official dataset DOI, corresponding to version 1.0.0. Access is free with registration.

returned_title: Prevention Survey Rhineland-Palatinate (2006) / Präventionssurvey Rheinland-Pfalz (2006)
justification: Official GESIS repository record containing the methodological documentation for the 2006 Prevention Survey Rhineland-Palatinate. The survey was conducted in November 2006 among residents of Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany, using a postal questionnaire. It included 990 respondents and collected information on vaccination status, self-assessed health, participation in preventive healthcare programs, prevention practices, and demographics. This is a verified match for the 2006 survey. The associated 2010 survey could not be independently verified from the available search results.

returned_title: Interval Study: Development Factors and Development Forms of Young People in the GDR (1968-1980) IS I - 1970 (3rd Wave)
justification: Exact match for the requested dataset. The study was conducted by the Zentralinstitut für Jugendforschung (ZIJ), Leipzig, and is archived by GESIS – Leibniz Institute for the Social Sciences. It is identified by DOI 10.4232/1.6151 and corresponds specifically to the third wave (1970) of the longitudinal Interval Study IS I (1968–1980). The research examines personality development and social behavior among young people in the German Democratic Republic (GDR), focusing on social influences and developmental conditions. The dataset includes survey data from eighth-grade students across 31 classes in 11 schools. It is part of a 12-wave longitudinal study archived under GESIS study numbers ZA6149–ZA6160.

returned_title: Politbarometer (February 1990) / Politbarometer (Februar 1990) – ZA1922
justification: Exact title match. The dataset was conducted by Forschungsgruppe Wahlen, Mannheim, in February 1990 and is identified by GESIS archive study number ZA1922. It examines German political attitudes, party preferences, voting intentions, satisfaction with democracy, evaluations of political leaders, and opinions on German reunification. The study is explicitly documented in GESIS's historical archive publications. The URL points to the GESIS study identifier, although the individual landing page could not be independently verified.

returned_title: Politbarometer 1977–2024 (Partial Cumulation) – ZA2391

This is an alternative source for analyzing the requested survey period.
